mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can impair buspirone metabolism via CYP3A4 and increase CNS effects; amphotericin B also causes direct nephrotoxic injury affecting drug clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and buspirone efficacy/toxicity closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; maintain electrolyte supplementation and ensure adequate hydration during concurrent use.
